desc: Read input $N$ and string $S$ from standard input.
Collect the indices of all '1's into a list `ones_indices`.
Compute the median value of the adjusted indices $q_j = \text{ones\_indices}[j] - j$.
Calculate the total cost by summing $|\text{ones\_indices}[j] - (\text{median} + j)|$ for all $j$.
Print the computed minimum number of swaps.
